name: Timesheets for Jira
tagline: Worklogs, timers, approvals, team view and reports, bucketed in each person's own timezone. Free for 10 users, then US$1 per user.
highlights: Your hours, on the days you worked them
Every worklog is bucketed in its author's timezone and never re-attributed to a service account, so a manager in London sees the days a Sydney engineer actually entered.
Log, edit and approve in one grid
Enter and edit worklogs inline, run a timer from the issue, submit the sheet and route it through multi-stage approvals with self-approval blocked by rule.
Time by project, issue, epic or person over any range, with working patterns, holidays, rounding policies, billable flags and CSV export.
